block_node.block_desc:
Simulates the pulse width modulation (PWM)
The block outputs either a switching pulse width modulated waveform or pass the duty cycle value to the output. Also, it generates an "Event" which can be used for synchronizing PWM with ADC or as PWM interrupts to trigger a control algorithm.

Simulates the analog-to-digital conversion (ADC)
The block samples the analog input based on a start event or sample time and outputs a representative digital value in counts. Also, it generate events which can be used for scheduling an algorithm.
Acquisition time and Conversion time parameter values sets the delays in the conversion.

The block outputs a message containing audio data. To access the data, connect the data output to Audio Capture device driver block and place the block in your application algorithm.
Set the Input parameter to 'From dialog' and set the Value parameter to specify the audio data. Set the Input to 'From input port' to receive audio data from the input port. Set the Input to 'From timeseries object' to input audio data and time values using timeseries object created in MATLAB.

The block outputs a message containing video data. To access the data, connect the data output to Video Capture device driver block and place the block in your application algorithm.
Set the Input parameter to 'From dialog' and set the Value parameter to specify the video data. Set the Input to 'From input port' to receive video data from the input port. Set the Input to 'From timeseries object' to input video data and time values using timeseries object created in MATLAB.
The block accepts audio data from Audio Playback device driver block. The block outputs or terminates the received data.
The block accepts video data from Video Display device driver block. The block outputs or terminates the received data.
